content: Statins competitively inhibit hepatic HMG-CoA reductase (the rate-limiting step in cholesterol synthesis). This reduces intrahepatical cholesterol, activating SREBP-2 and upregulating LDL receptor (LDLR) gene expression. Increased LDLR density enhances hepatic LDL uptake, lowering plasma LDL-C. (Compact mechanism: target → hepatic regulation shift → LDLR effect.)
